scenario.name: crying-care
scenario.title: Care and boundaries
scenario.subtitle: Uncertain signs of distress, a request for space, and moments where it must say what it cannot do.
scenario.limitation: The temporal Care Cue is exercised only with synthetic detector signals; the robot is simulated. No real camera or Misty II was used.
